statements_used: The standard trial is 3 days and starts when a trial server is created.
Cloudways says it does not provide permanent free hosting; paid use after trial is pay-as-you-go.
Charges depend on the server plan, provider, server size, bandwidth and paid add-ons.
The standard trial does not require a credit card.
Usage is invoiced at the start of the following month.
A card authorization may be temporarily $1 and reversed; PayPal $5 is applied toward balance or next invoice.
Autonomous has a 3-day trial without requiring a card to start.
If a payment method was already added, Cloudways says the account is automatically upgraded to Plan 1 after the trial.
The article says delete the application or unsubscribe before expiry to avoid the automatic upgrade.
